patch_description:
The previous approach uses one demand-first greedy ordering, followed by strictly max-KVPR-improving moves and swaps. Its key parameters are the model ordering `(req_rate / slo, model_size)`, one greedy construction pass, an improvement bound of `len(models) * gpu_num`, and an improvement threshold of `1e-12`.

This version improves placement quality with a deterministic multi-start configuration. It constructs several initial placements using different selection criteria: high request pressure first, large-memory models first, pressure-per-memory first, and mixed pressure/size orderings. Each greedy decision minimizes the full sorted GPU-pressure vector, not only the current maximum, which also balances secondary bottleneck GPUs. The best initial placement is then improved with bottleneck-focused moves and swaps. Local search accepts lexicographic pressure-vector improvements, allowing equal-maximum moves that reduce secondary pressure and create better future improvements. The search uses an adaptive iteration budget proportional to both model and GPU count.
